rule: A scanned standard library is the scan's own code (SPEC Decisions 2026-11-12): when the scan contains the standard library's sources, a Stdlib call, bare or written Stdlib.f, resolves to that definition at high, as List.map resolves to list.map. Names it does not define keep the external form Stdlib.f, medium.
source: SPEC Decisions (2026-11-12): the OCaml compiler repo's stdlib/stdlib.ml
notes: print_string (bare) and Stdlib.failwith (qualified) are defined in the scanned stdlib.ml: high, one ID with the definition (C1). ignore and raise are not defined in this stdlib.ml, so they stay Stdlib.ignore / Stdlib.raise, medium.
